secondary.title: Alexander the Great: The Hunt for a New Past
secondary.author: Paul Cartledge
secondary.rationale: Paul Cartledge is a distinguished historian of ancient Greece, and this book offers a comprehensive and modern scholarly assessment of Alexander's life and legacy.

secondary.title: Alexander the Great
secondary.author: Robin Lane Fox
secondary.rationale: While slightly before the 1976 cutoff, Robin Lane Fox's biography is considered a seminal work on Alexander, widely respected for its scholarship and detail. It has been reissued and remains influential.

secondary.title: The Campaigns of Alexander
secondary.author: Arrian
secondary.rationale: Arrian's 'Anabasis Alexandri' is one of the most important and reliable ancient sources for Alexander's military campaigns. While the original text is ancient, modern scholarly editions and translations are widely available.

suggestions.notes: Direct primary sources authored by Alexander the Great himself (letters, speeches) are extremely scarce and often of questionable authenticity or only preserved through later historians. Therefore, no direct primary sources are listed. Arrian is included as a primary source from antiquity, but the listed year refers to a notable English translation.
